tools.name: exis_list_local_docs
tools.description: Lists all available ExisJS documentation files.

tools.name: exis_read_local_docs
tools.description: Reads an ExisJS documentation file by its relative path.

filePath.description: The relative path to the documentation file (e.g., content/routing.mdx).

tools.name: exis_generate_route
tools.description: Scaffolds an idiomatic ExisJS route file.

filePath.description: The absolute or relative path to the route file to create (e.g., src/http/users/route.ts).

paradigm.description: The ExisJS routing paradigm to use.

tools.name: exis_generate_boundary
tools.description: Scaffolds an idiomatic ExisJS Boundary (boundary.ts) for applying middleware/CORS/DI to a folder route.

filePath.description: The path to the boundary file to create (e.g., src/http/admin/boundary.ts).

paradigm.description: The ExisJS routing paradigm to use.

tools.name: exis_generate_schema
tools.description: Scaffolds an idiomatic ExisJS schema file (schema.ts) using the native tex validator and ResolveSchema.

filePath.description: The path to the schema file to create (e.g., src/http/users/schema.ts).

tools.name: exis_generate_plugin
tools.description: Scaffolds an idiomatic ExisJS Plugin using definePlugin.

filePath.description: The path to the plugin file to create (e.g., src/plugins/my.plugin.ts).

name.description: The name of the plugin (e.g., MyPlugin).

tools.name: exis_generate_config
tools.description: Scaffolds a standard exis.config.ts file in the root of the project.
